scope: Any contract projection whose schema explicitly declares YAYA_CANONICAL_JSON_V1, including Evidence.payload and Product Experience draft, patch, and embedded-feedback projections.
rules: The canonical byte sequence is UTF-8 without a byte-order mark.
Object keys are sorted by ascending Unicode scalar value and encoded recursively.
Strings use JSON escaping while non-ASCII Unicode scalar values remain unescaped.
Strings and object keys containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate are rejected as ill-formed Unicode.
Numbers are restricted to safe integers and use base-10 notation; negative zero is encoded as zero.
null and booleans use the lowercase JSON tokens.
